steps.name: triage
steps.goal: Find affected services, severity inputs and recent changes.

steps.name: diagnose
steps.goal: Test hypotheses for each suspect within the tool budget.

steps.name: runbook
steps.goal: Match the top hypothesis to a runbook and check past lessons.

steps.name: propose
steps.goal: Propose one allow-listed action with its rollback.

steps.name: verify
steps.goal: Confirm the expected effect is sustained, else roll back.

steps.name: communicate
steps.goal: Draft status notes and the postmortem for review.

steps.name: learn
steps.goal: Store reviewed lessons with their preconditions.

internal.title: High Error Rate Alert on flagd Service - Escalated
internal.body: At 11:41 UTC on 2026-11-08, an alert for high error rate was triggered on the flagd service. Initial diagnosis was performed, but no conclusive evidence was found to determine the root cause. At 12:00 UTC, the incident was escalated to the on-call engineer for further investigation. No resolution or recovery was confirmed at the time of escalation.

external.title: Intermittent Errors Observed on Feature Flag Service
external.body: Between 11:41 and 12:00 UTC on 2026-11-08, some customers may have experienced intermittent errors when using the feature flag service. Our team detected the issue and escalated it for further investigation. We are actively working to identify and resolve the cause.

output.summary: An alert for high error rate was triggered on the flagd service, leading to escalation for further investigation without immediate resolution.
output.impact: Some customers may have experienced intermittent errors with the feature flag service during the incident window.
output.root_cause: No root cause was identified or confirmed as the incident was escalated without conclusive evidence or recovery verification.
output.resolution: The incident was escalated to the on-call engineer for further diagnosis; no resolution was confirmed at the time of reporting.

lessons.lesson: When no conclusive evidence is found during initial diagnosis, escalate promptly to ensure timely expert intervention.
lessons.applies_when: The error rate on flagd service exceeds 5% and initial diagnosis does not yield a root cause.

action_items: Continue investigation with on-call engineer to identify root cause and implement fix.
Improve monitoring to capture more diagnostic data for faster root cause analysis in future incidents.
